title: energy-proxy: SCED rebaseline analysis stack for a single-household HVAC controller field study
description: Real-time and historical residential energy monitoring with dynamic-pricing-aware HVAC scheduling, plus the analysis pipeline that supports a pre-registered single-case experimental design (SCED) field study comparing the CTK04AE thermostat's programmed schedule (Arm A) against the active hvac-scheduler controller (Arm B: RTP/DTOD/5CP-risk-aware RBC with safety supervisor). Conducted as building-as-subject measurement by an unaffiliated owner-investigator in a single Plainfield, IL household over the 2026 cooling season (2026-06-01 through 2026-11-16, 12 arm periods of 14 days each). Binding pre-registration spec lives at docs/plans/sced-rebaseline-spec-2026-05-13.md within the tagged release.
